items.summary: One point off the shred (-13%->-12%) is cosmetic alone, but it lands opposite Hollow Point's buff, so the two cheap shred items now sit 2 points apart where they were 4. Marginal for Venator's lane math, real only as relative pressure.

affected_heroes.why: His gun-bruiser lane uses Weakening Headshot, and the resist-shred edge it gave is now smaller against Hollow Point buyers.

items.build_shift: Widens the gap to Hollow Point; users splashing shred should now default to the cheaper Hollow Point for the same slot.

items.summary: +1% resist-shred on the tempo meta's cheap early-gun item compounds with the shredded comeback economy: winning lane with a gun carry converts harder, and Hollow Point is the first brick of that plan. Small number, correct-direction nudge.

affected_heroes.why: Gun carry who wants lane pressure early; the cheapest shred item got better in a lane-wins-meta.
Snowballing lane gun tank benefits from an early shred spike before her tank items come online.
His current real build is spirit, not the old KB gun core, so the buff mostly passes him by.

items.build_shift: Firms up against Weakening Headshot as the default early-shred buy on gun carries.

items.summary: Spirit scaling 0.005->0.006 (+20%) matters most to spirit-hybrid buyers, and it gains relative value as the patch trims Decay's DPS and squeezes healers. Still the cleanest HP-inflation answer in the meta.

affected_heroes.why: His spirit build already out-performs his gun build; a scaling buff feeds that path and his burn plan.
Spirit-amp hybrid runs Toxic Bullets as its gun piece; the buff adds damage to an archetype that otherwise gets punished by tempo.
On-hit gun line leans on Toxic Bullets vs tanks; a small buff is a rare positive for the worst-early-game carry.

items.build_shift: With Decay's DPS cut 25%, Toxic Bullets is now the better sustained anti-heal/burn option for hybrid carries.

items.summary: Gaining Sprint Boots as a component plus faster sprint and a 45->37s cooldown turns a called-out-bad item into a real invis-engage option, exactly as Veil Walker sheds the same Sprint Boots path. It inherits the component and the niche at once.

affected_heroes.why: His Veil Walker just lost Sprint Boots and movespeed-on-break, so the now-buffed Shadow Weave is the natural weapon-slot replacement for invis engage.
A gun carry wanting survivability can now buy Sprint Boots into Shadow Weave instead of the stripped Veil Walker.

items.build_shift: Takes over the Sprint Boots component Veil Walker lost; the two invis items have swapped roles.

items.summary: Bounty 180->170% trims the farm-bankroll engine slightly, part of the wider soul-economy tightening. It doesn't change who buys it, just how fast it snowballs a lead the patch already rewards.

affected_heroes.why: His farm/tempo hybrid opens Cultist Sacrifice to fund a jungle soul lead; a smaller bounty slows the very lead the tempo meta now rewards.
Cloak-skirmish line uses Cultist Sacrifice for farm speed; trimmed payout compounds his falling tempo profile.

items.summary: A 14->20s duration (+43%) on a near-unbought utility item makes uptime the selling point rather than a brief window. Could pull it out of the unused bin for ability-weaving casters.
items.build_shift: Niche spirit utility; longer uptime makes it a plausible pick-up for high-cast-frequency spirit builds that previously ignored the 14s window.

items.summary: Slower buildup plus spirit power 40->30 and fire rate 30->25% is a triple cut, and it stacks on Mercurial Magnum's nerf and Plated Armor's fix to kill the on-hit spirit carry build outright. The 'Mercurial-carry' identity has no leg left.

affected_heroes.why: His gun build leans on Spiritual Overflow; that item set was already his weaker-performing line and now collapses further.
Spiritual Overflow is a named T4 gun finisher for him, and he was already the patch's clearest late-scaler casualty; losing this removes his capped-ceiling spike.

items.build_shift: The Mercurial Magnum + Spiritual Overflow package is no longer buyable as a coherent build.

items.summary: Small heal/stack-range trims land alongside the Radiant Regeneration cut, so the sustain-support item class is squeezed from two directions at once. Effect is cumulative, not dramatic.

affected_heroes.why: His spirit-support line runs Restorative Locket; a smaller heal lowers the sustain that made him 'unkillable with Locket + Dispel.'
Locket is part of her regen stack, itself a late-scaler tool the tempo meta already punishes.

items.build_shift: Pairs with the Radiant Regeneration nerf—sustain supports lose healing efficiency broadly.

items.summary: Souls/min 18->16 is a straight econ trim on a tempo-farm item; it stays correct on early-bruiser heroes but banks a smaller lead into a patch that rewards banking leads.

affected_heroes.why: His spirit-bruiser build opens Trophy Collector for early tempo; trimmed payout slightly blunts his lane-to-item-curve conversion.
Anti-heal bruiser line uses Trophy Collector; a smaller soul trickle is a minor tax on his early-bruiser floor.

items.summary: Losing the Sprint Boots component, the +2 sprint/regen, the movespeed-on-break, and 4 spirit power demotes it from the game's auto-buy disengage to a pick-hero commit. Heroes who used it purely for a reliable bail-out lost their escape valve.

affected_heroes.why: A 77%-buy core; losing Sprint Boots and movespeed-on-break strips the dive-cover that made his hook combo safe to commit to.
She leaned on Veil Walker as a disengage for her low-HP assassin commit; the KB flags exactly this loss as her rising-trend caveat.
Cooldown Cube shell runs Veil Walker; without Sprint Boots and movespeed-on-break his enabler mobility takes a second hit on top of his own 09-16 nerfs.
Kidnap/utility line uses Veil Walker to isolate and escape; the stripped version weakens an already low-WR pick build.

items.build_shift: Loses Sprint Boots entirely—the component and the invis niche both migrate to Shadow Weave.

items.summary: Max-health regen 2->2.25% is quiet sustain tuning, but it gains outsized value in a tempo patch: surviving the post-nerf burst windows is exactly what each new regeneration tick buys. No buyer changes.

affected_heroes.why: Default survivability slot on nearly every bruiser; marginal sustain gain compounds into the tempo frontline he wants to be.
Lane-bullying frontline that wants to snowball off early kills; a slightly better regen tick helps him stay in the brawl that the patch rewards.

items.summary: Melee-heal up to 120+1.75 and 35% healing, combined with slows now biting air drag, turns Lifestrike's 48% slow into genuine CC on top of the heal. It goes from heal item to heal-and-lockdown on the right hero.

affected_heroes.why: The prime spammed buyer: buffed melee heal plus a slow that now also drags airborne targets makes him a stickier brawler in a lane-wins meta.

items.build_shift: Its slow now functions against flyers, giving melee bruisers a new answer to airborne poke heroes.

items.summary: Bullet+spirit lifesteal 25->28% on a generally-weak T4 doesn't fix its slot problem, but broader lifesteal buffs make a sustain-carry line marginally more viable. Not a core shift.
items.build_shift: Still loses to cheaper lifesteal items in the same slot; a small nudge that won't promote it to core.

items.summary: A meaningful fix, not a cosmetic one: on-hit prevention now actually blocks the follow-up spirit damage from Mercurial Magnum, Vindicta's Flight, Wraith's Full Auto, and Tesla Bullets/Capacitor. It becomes a genuine counter-item against mixed-damage on-hit carries.

affected_heroes.why: Plated Armor now blanks Full Auto's spirit damage outright, on top of her Mercurial Magnum nerf—her primary on-hit build loses its damage and its counter is live.
Her Mercurial Magnum spirit splice and Tesla Bullets/AoE are now blocked; a popular counter to a 54.6%-WR carry.
Flight on-hit damage is now blocked by a common Vitality buy, adding to her flyer penalties.

items.build_shift: Promotes Plated Armor as an anti-on-hit counter worth slotting when facing spirit-on-hit carries.

items.summary: A new +10% Ultimate Ability Cooldown Reduction turns a defense item into an ult-uptime enabler, opening it up to any hero whose win condition is an ultimate. That's a real new function, not a stat tweak.

affected_heroes.why: His value is initiation via a fight-defining ultimate; faster ult cooldown directly compounds his impact.
Rising S-tier gun tank with an initiation tool; ult-uptime utility fits her front-line commit pattern.

items.build_shift: Adds an ult-CDR reason to buy it beyond raw spirit defense—potentially a new option for ult-reliant tanks.

items.summary: A bigger damage penalty, a lower soul rate, and—critically—stored souls now counting toward net worth make a greed econ item unplayable. The net-worth clause matters even with comeback gutted: it can't hide a lead from bounty math anymore.
items.build_shift: Effectively removed from the item pool; no build should route through it.

items.summary: Cooldown 27->29s is a real but small tax, largely offset by the air-drag change that makes its slow bite airborne heroes. Net it stays a near-every-game pick item with slightly worse uptime and better target coverage.

affected_heroes.why: Hook-into-Slowing-Hex chain is his default; +2s cooldown slightly lowers how often he converts a pick.
Tempo-support and CC-lockdown lines buy it; the cooldown tax roughly washes against its new anti-flyer value.
Uses it to set up picks; the slow's new reach on airborne targets offsets the longer cooldown.

items.build_shift: Lowers buy priority marginally, but its air-drag slow keeps it a live pick tool against flyers.

items.summary: Per-boon scaling 2->1.7 stacks on the 08-22 base heal cut, a cumulative efficiency hit to the healing item four sustain heroes build around. In a lane-wins meta it removes their ability to absorb an early deficit.

affected_heroes.why: Radiant Regeneration is central to her sustain-burst stack; nerf lands on top of seven direct 09-16 hits.
His 97% core regen item is trimmed while he rises on sustain; a smaller heal weakens the ramping-frontline identity.
A 98%-buy item for her regen gun-bruiser; the cut caps exactly the tank/regen core that has been propping her rise.
Healing-support buyer; fewer effective heals per boon lowers his rescue value.

items.build_shift: Part of a broad healing-item squeeze with Restorative Locket—sustain supports lose cumulative throughput.

items.summary: Current-health bonus 8->7.5% is a cumulative trim on top of 07-28's item-proc removal, softening the anti-tank slot without removing it. Still correct into the tank-heavy tempo frontline.

affected_heroes.why: His current-HP identity is anti-tank; the shared anti-tank item got slightly weaker against the fronts he farms.
Ability-burst line splashes Tankbuster for %HP into tanks; marginally less efficient vs the rising tank wave.
Utility bruiser line buys it into enemy fronts; the nerf shaves her anti-tank contribution.

items.summary: DPS -25% but duration +20% trades burst healing-cut for longer sustained anti-heal; it stays the go-to anti-heal slot. The rebalance shifts it slightly toward drawn-out fights and away from bursting a heal-window down.

affected_heroes.why: Extended-burn builds prefer longer duration, but he needs burst anti-heal less in a narrower-healing meta.
Scorn sustain fights run long, so the longer duration suits him; the DPS loss is a wash vs tanks.
Buys it for anti-heal pressure in extended frontline brawls the duration change slightly favors.

items.build_shift: Still the default anti-heal slot; with healing items nerfed, Decay's job narrows toward sustained fights.

items.summary: Base bullet damage 25->20% and scaling 0.49->0.38 is a heavy cut, and it lands with Spiritual Overflow's nerf and Plated Armor's fix to kill the Mercurial on-hit carry archetype outright. The T4 spirit-on-hit capstone loses its reason to exist.

affected_heroes.why: Mercurial Magnum is her ~93%-share mid-late capstone; the nerf removes real gun damage from an A-tier 54.6% WR carry.
A 93%-share signature item of her spirit on-hit build; paired with the Plated Armor fix, her entire damage plan is hollowed out.
Named T4 gun finisher; the cut reinforces his falling-late-scaler read in a meta that ends games early.

items.build_shift: The on-hit spirit package (Mercurial Magnum + Spiritual Overflow) is dead; buyers must pivot to pure gun or spirit lines.

items.summary: Damage 30->35% and cast range 20->25m make a cleansable niche spirit-amp more of a standoff pick, which suits a meta rewarding ranged initiation before tempo comps close. Still niche, now less embarrassing.
items.build_shift: Longer range lets a poke/setup caster apply it from safer distance; competes with Tankbuster's slot for spirit-amp buyers but remains cleansable, so it stays situational.

notable_item_stories: The on-hit spirit archetype is gutted three ways at once—Mercurial Magnum nerfed, Spiritual Overflow nerfed, Plated Armor now blocks the spirit damage—so Wraith, Warden, and Vyper lose a core build in one patch.

The two invis items swapped identities: Veil Walker lost Sprint Boots and movespeed-on-break while Shadow Weave gained Sprint Boots plus faster sprint and cooldown, so expect more Shadow Weave on gun carries and fewer auto-buy Veil Walkers.

Healing items took cumulative hits (Radiant Regeneration, Restorative Locket) while anti-heal-slot Decay was retuned and Toxic Bullets nudged up—sustain supports like Celeste, Shiv, and Lady Geist lose throughput even as the tempo meta punishes exactly the farm-then-scale pattern they need.
